title: 习近平定调AI安全可：全球治理框架如何落地，技术自主与开放边界在哪？
speaker: Xi Jinping

segments.en: AI should be a trusted tool for humanity.
segments.zh: 人工智能应该成为人类信赖的工具。

segments.en: We should take seriously the various types of inherent and secondary risks that AI may trigger.
segments.zh: 我们要认真对待人工智能可能引发的各类固有风险和衍生风险。

segments.en: We should put in place laws and regulations, technological monitoring, early warning and emergency response systems.
segments.zh: 要建立法律法规、技术监测、预警和应急响应体系。

segments.en: in order to strengthen the line of security, prevent abuses and vicious use, and ensure that AI is always under human control.
segments.zh: 筑牢安全防线，防止滥用和恶意使用，确保人工智能始终处于人类控制之下。

segments.en: In the meantime, we should jointly oppose overstretching the national security concept in the field of AI.
segments.zh: 同时，要共同反对在人工智能领域泛化国家安全概念。
